items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Robinson and I -- we were in partnership owning the act. We owned the act, Clarence Robinson and myself.

ctx.x: How long -- you were on the road with that group. How long did you travel with them from the west coast to New York?

Oh, I stayed with that group until -- one trip. Then we came back and we organized this group of our own -- Liza and her Shuffling Sextet. That was the group -- Fats Waller was the pianist, Clarence Robinson was the dancer, Katie Crippen was the singer, I played clarinet, and then we had a trumpet player and a trombone player whom I've forgotten.
Fats Waller was in this group --
